decisionRecord.summary: ClisTa can conditionally transfer a scoped MRM task: an independent receiver reconstructed this thread from the log alone and accepted the bounded scope as structure transfer, so conditional transferability is verified; verified-success beyond structure remains withheld.
decisionRecord.rationale: Five reproducible sealed dry-run logs, continuity export/verify, bounded delegation, and the prompt-pack transfer-state contract establish the mechanism; the receiver read-back (integrity --strict + continuity projection_hash match on repo HEAD 16e7c16, formal conditional acceptance) discharged the blocking objection that no handoff had been observed. The decision stays conditional because two harvested objections survive it: continuity packets carry no projector identity (upstream ClisTa-Protocol issue #64, demonstrated stale-checkout false negative) and cross-engine interpretation drift on the receiver-compatibility assumption is unverified.
conditions: Acceptance covers reproducible structure only — not correctness, endorsement, or audit of the transferred recommendation (trusted:false / unaudited)
The handoff confers no institutional model-risk authority; endorsement and deployment trust must be granted separately by the institution
Pin the projector identity / repo ref for continuity verification until upstream issue #64 lands — cross-runtime verification is checkout-sensitive
Cross-engine invariance remains an open verification task: promote beyond conditional only after a receiver on a different inference engine reproduces a matching objection set from the same packet
decisionRecord.nextAction: Run the cross-engine invariance check (second receiver, different inference engine, same packet) and track upstream #64 for projector identity in continuity packets; a new decision is required to promote beyond conditional.
